model.name: gpt-oss-20b (agent, explain only)
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (3.6B active), MXFP4 as released. The model approved today; the baseline every other profile is read against.

answers.sql:
SELECT d_chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM txn;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE t.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN target_date td ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K
)
SELECT dc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, c.cnt AS complaint_count
FROM c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dc ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = dc.CMPLT_CTG_K
ORDER BY c.cnt DESC;

WITH last_aug AS (
  SELECT MAX(dt.DT_K) AS last_day
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  WHERE dt.MTH_NBR = 8 AND dt.IS_MTH_END
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN last_aug la ON dt.DT_K = la.last_day
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT d.ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACCT_K) AS num_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT d
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.OPND_DT)=2025
GROUP BY d.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CTY_NM, a.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON a.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT CTY_NM, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM t
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_usd
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, MTH_NBR, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM current_customers c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
    AND ddt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'::date
    AND ddt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'::date
  GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM, cnt FROM c ORDER BY cnt DESC;

WITH fee AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, d.CAL_DT, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM fee
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1='FRAUD' AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR=2025;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.TXN_CNT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT)::int AS year, SUM(TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM txn
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT)::int IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT dpr.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(fb.otstn_prncp_amt) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fb.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dpr ON fb.LN_PRD_K = dpr.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dd.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dpr.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'::date
    AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'::date
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON wr.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         branch_name,
         atm_txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.ORGNL_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)=2025
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH cust_curr AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), trf AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM trf t
JOIN cust_curr c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire w
JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel, SUM(t.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND ch.IS_CURR
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'::date AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'::date
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K AND d.IS_CURR
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count FROM disputes;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN target_date t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = true;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_aug AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.dt_k) AS last_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.cal_dt) = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.cust_k) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
JOIN last_aug la ON d.dt_k = la.last_date
WHERE fd.dflt_flg = TRUE;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_fx_rate DESC;

SELECT m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT)=2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC;

WITH q1_2025 AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND QTR_NBR = 1
)
SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN q1_2025 d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(RPRTN_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT >= '2025-12-01' AND CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD';

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM current_customers cc
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 tx ON cc.CUST_K = tx.CUST_K
WHERE tx.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT d2.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d2 ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d2.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
GROUP BY d2.DSPLY_NM;

WITH fee AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, d.CAL_DT, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM fee
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1='FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction_name
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K, d_dt.cal_dt, d_chnl.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cal_dt)::int AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product,
  SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D b
JOIN target_date d ON b.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM transfers t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND br.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.MRCH_K, a.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), merch AS (
  SELECT m.MRCH_K, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_MRCH m
  WHERE m.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(a.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth a
JOIN merch m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), c AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM f JOIN c USING (CUST_K)
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1,
  SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM d)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND d.IS_CURR
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND d.IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT w.BUS_ID FROM wire w
  JOIN atm a ON w.BUS_ID = a.BUS_ID
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_CD1 AS currency_code, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT currency_code, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM t
GROUP BY currency_code
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel, SUM(t.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND ch.IS_CURR
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BR_K,
         br.DSPLY_NM,
         d.CAL_YR_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT * FROM txn ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_aug AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS last_date
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON d.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
JOIN last_aug la ON dd.DT_K = la.last_date
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1, AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT a.BR_K, b.CTY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K AND b.IS_CURR
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAL_DT) AS mon
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.yr = 2025
  AND d.mon = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month, COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
WHERE d.IS_CURR = true
  AND d.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM cust2025);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

WITH d AS (SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT)
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.DSC ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH latest_bal AS (
  SELECT f.LN_PRD_K, f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM latest_bal b
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM transfers;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM txn t1
WHERE (region_code, txn_count) IN (
  SELECT region_code, MAX(txn_count) FROM txn GROUP BY region_code
);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_YR_NBR, c.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG c ON m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 = c.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND c.IS_CURR
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT c.CUST_K
  FROM wire w
  JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
